title: 2021-01 — Michelson v. Northwest Georgia Presbytery
disposition_detail: SJC found the complaint administratively out of order as prematurely filed because Presbytery had not completed its hearing on the complaint when Michelson filed with the SJC. It reset the complainant's time to elevate the complaint to begin on the later of notification of the SJC action or Presbytery's ruling on the complaint. No merits ruling.
first_summary: The SJC found Michelson's complaint against Northwest Georgia Presbytery administratively out of order because it was filed before Presbytery completed its hearing. It reset the complainant's time to elevate the complaint to run from the later of notice of the SJC action or Presbytery's ruling. Approved 22-0-0.
summary: The SJC held that Stuart Michelson's complaint against Northwest Georgia Presbytery was administratively out of order because he filed it with the SJC before Presbytery had completed its hearing on the complaint. The SJC did not reach the merits. It reset Michelson's time to elevate the complaint to run from the later of notification of the SJC's action or Presbytery's ruling on the complaint. Approved 22-0-0.
